verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares is a web-based SaaS equity-management platform, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, cookie preferences, or any tracking opt-out control. The docs cover only cap table, data room, workflow and integration features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
